title: Bird nest
blurb: A bird nest is the spot in which a bird lays and incubates its eggs and raises its young.
facts: For some species, a nest is simply a shallow depression made in sand; for others, it is the knot-hole left by a broken branch, a burrow dug into the ground, a chamber drilled into...
Some birds, including magpies, have been observed building nests using anti-bird spikes.
In some cases, these nests can contain up to 1,500 metal spikes.
